title: Celastrol induces DNA damage and cell death in BCR-ABL T315I-mutant CML by targeting YY1 and HMCES.
authors: Yang, Fan; Zhou, Hongchao; Luo, Piao; Jia, Lin; Hou, Mengyun; Huang, Jingnan; Gao, Lin; Zhang, Qian; Guan, Yudong; Bao, Honglei; Zhang, Baotong; Liu, Liping; Zou, Chang; Yang, Qinhe; Wang, Jigang; Dai, Lingyun
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物Celastrol通过靶向YY1和HMCES诱导DNA损伤杀伤耐药CML细胞，虽涉及蛋白-DNA损伤修复相关蛋白，但核心是药物靶点鉴定与细胞死亡机制，无TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅含分子对接辅助验证，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) is driven primarily by the constitutively active BCR-ABL fusion oncoprotein. Although the development of tyrosine kinase inhibitors has markedly improved the prognosis of CML patients, it remains a significant challenge to overcome drug-resistant mutations, such as the T315I mutation of BCR-ABL, and achieve treatment-free remission in the clinic. PURPOSE: The identification of new intervention targets beyond BCR-ABL could provide new perspectives for future research and therapeutic intervention. A network pharmacology analysis was conducted to identify the most promising natural product with anti-CML activity. Celastrol was selected for further analysis to gain insights into its mechanism of action (MoA), with the aim of identifying potential new intervention targets for BCR-ABL T315I-mutant CML. METHODS: Transcriptomic and proteomic analyses were conducted to systematically investigate the molecular MoA of celastrol in K562(T315I) cells. To identify the target proteins of celastrol, mass spectrometry-coupled cellular thermal shift assay (MS-CETSA) was carried out, followed by validations with genetic knockdown and overexpression, cell proliferation assay, comet assay, Western blotting, celastrol probe-based in situ labeling and pull-down assay, molecular docking, and biolayer interferometry. RESULTS: Our multi-omics analyses revealed that celastrol primarily induces DNA damage accumulation and the unfolded protein response in K562(T315I) cells. Among the twelve most potential celastrol targets, experimental evidence demonstrated that the direct interaction of celastrol with YY1 and HMCES increases the levels of DNA damage, leading to cell death. CONCLUSION: This study represents the first investigation utilizing a proteome-wide label-free target deconvolution approach, MS-CETSA, to identify the protein targets of celastrol. This study also develops a new systems pharmacology strategy. The findings provide new insights into the multifaceted mechanisms of celastrol and, more importantly, highlight the potential of targeting proteins in DNA damage and repair pathways, particularly YY1 and HMCES, to combat drug-resistant CML.
abstract_zh: 背景：慢性髓性白血病（CML）主要由持续活化的BCR-ABL融合癌蛋白驱动。尽管酪氨酸激酶抑制剂的发展显著改善了CML患者的预后，但在临床上克服耐药性突变（如BCR-ABL的T315I突变）并实现无治疗缓解仍是一项重大挑战。目的：识别BCR-ABL之外的新干预靶点可为未来研究和治疗干预提供新视角。通过网络药理学分析，筛选出最具抗CML活性的天然产物。选择雷公藤红素（celastrol）进行进一步分析，以深入了解其作用机制（MoA），旨在为BCR-ABL T315I突变型CML识别潜在的新干预靶点。方法：采用转录组学和蛋白质组学分析，系统研究雷公藤红素在K562(T315I)细胞中的分子MoA。为鉴定雷公藤红素的靶蛋白，进行了质谱联用细胞热位移分析（MS-CETSA），随后通过基因敲低和过表达、细胞增殖实验、彗星实验、Western blotting、基于雷公藤红素探针的原位标记和下拉实验、分子对接及生物层干涉法进行验证。结果：我们的多组学分析揭示，雷公藤红素主要诱导K562(T315I)细胞中的DNA损伤积累和未折叠蛋白反应。在十二个最可能的雷公藤红素靶点中，实验证据表明，雷公藤红素与YY1和HMCES的直接相互作用增加了DNA损伤水平，导致细胞死亡。结论：本研究首次利用蛋白质组-wide无标记靶点去卷积方法MS-CETSA来鉴定雷公藤红素的蛋白靶点，并开发了一种新的系统药理学策略。研究结果为雷公藤红素的多方面机制提供了新见解，更重要的是，强调了靶向DNA损伤和修复通路中的蛋白（特别是YY1和HMCES）以对抗耐药性CML的潜力。
